  "cons": [

    "Customer support can be slow or difficult to navigate for complex business issues."

  "overall_experience": "The Senior Finance & Accounts Executive likely found PayPal Payments to be a convenient and widely accepted tool for transactional needs, appreciating its ease of use for making purchases and receiving funds. While functional for basic tasks, it may not fully meet the comprehensive needs of a finance professional managing a mid-market company's accounts."
